title: BTicino MH200 (FW 2.1.0) command-session replies to tested WHO 25 frames

environment.bus_topology: Privacy-filtered capture from a live main SCS bus; no WHO 25 transmitter or dry-contact/IR interface was installed or configured.

device_under_test.description: MH200 gateway under test, identified by product model and firmware; no installed hardware identifier is retained.

summary: Contributor-recorded MH200 firmware 2.1.0 replies to eight literal WHO 25 probes were NACK, with measured socket latency 14.686..57.430 ms. The contributor declared a 2000 ms dual-session observation window per probe; no WHO 25 event frame occurs in the recording. Incoming WHO 25 hardware events and physical bus forwarding were not tested. This is a privacy projection of the retained contributor recording, not a new hardware run.
test_recipe: Open concurrent event (*99*1##) and command (*99*0##) TCP sessions on port 20000; authentication is excluded from the public projection.
Identify the gateway with *#13**15##, *#13**16##, *#13**23##, *#13**24## and *#1013*0*1##; retain data and ACK replies.

Use *#9*0## as a positive command/event control. During a ten-second manual window, press a physical lighting control to confirm real bus events reach the monitor; its address is replaced by synthetic WHERE 99 in this projection.
Send literal probe *25*21#1*21## separately and observe both sessions for the declared 2000 ms window. Recorded command reply: NACK after 57.430 ms.
Send literal probe *25*11#0*11## separately and observe both sessions for the declared 2000 ms window. Recorded command reply: NACK after 25.392 ms.
Send literal probe *#25*21## separately and observe both sessions for the declared 2000 ms window. Recorded command reply: NACK after 19.576 ms.
Send literal probe *25*11#121*10## separately and observe both sessions for the declared 2000 ms window. Recorded command reply: NACK after 23.398 ms.
Send literal probe *25*12*131## separately and observe both sessions for the declared 2000 ms window. Recorded command reply: NACK after 34.942 ms.
Send literal probe *25*23#8*233## separately and observe both sessions for the declared 2000 ms window. Recorded command reply: NACK after 24.200 ms.
Send literal probe *25*31#1*339## separately and observe both sessions for the declared 2000 ms window. Recorded command reply: NACK after 39.486 ms.
Send literal probe *25*32#1*33## separately and observe both sessions for the declared 2000 ms window. Recorded command reply: NACK after 14.686 ms.
